name: phase7_answer_judge_v2
frozen: 2026-11-11, before any v2 judge output exists. The 50 answers are the same ones v1 judged and three reviewers read, so v2 changes were designed on them: v2 numbers are in-sample for the prompt and reference changes.
purpose: Record the faithfulness and correctness of the agent's code and docs answers with a local open-source LLM judge. Not a gate on answer quality: the judge itself is gated by negative controls.

judge_model.resolved_to: Qwen3.8-27B (Hugging Face metadata lists 28B parameters; no model named Qwen3.7-28B was found)
judge_model.note: The default is a third-party 4-bit build (compressed-tensors W4A16, group size 32, about 21 GB) that vLLM runs with Marlin kernels on an A100. The alternative is the official block-wise FP8 release, which an A100 has no hardware for (untested). Record whichever ran. Thinking mode is off; each verdict carries a short written reason instead.

controls: Each answer is paired with a different same-type question's evidence (a derangement, seeded). Faithfulness control: the answer with another answer's cited lines, expected `unfaithful`. Correctness control: the answer judged against another question's reference, expected `incorrect`. An unparsable control counts as not rejected.
retry_note: Your reply was not valid JSON with an allowed verdict. Reply again with only the JSON object.
reading_the_result: If the controls gate fails the judge is not trusted and no answer-quality number is recorded. If it passes, record the rates per type and read every disagreement with the mechanical score before quoting them.
not_measured: Answer quality for history, refs, kind, prsearch, commit and probe questions (scored exactly by eval/agent_eval.py).
Whether the judge agrees with a person: no human labels exist for these answers.
Self-preference: the judge is from the Qwen family like the answer model. Not tested.
Docs reference sections are chosen by a keyword score, so a question may get a section that does not hold the answer; the selected headings are listed in items.json.
The v2 prompts have not been tried on answers outside the 50 used to design them.
changes_from_v1: prompt_version v2: faithfulness judges only what the answer asserts (omissions and a wider-than-needed cited range are not unsupported claims); correctness ignores cited paths and line numbers and marks an answer partial when it omits something the question asks for.

reference_mode sections: for docs, the reference is the up-to-3 sections of each named file most about the question (stem match, heading weighted, rarity weighted), not the first 7000 characters. In v1 the reference for docs-045/046/047/050 did not contain the answer's section and the judge called two right answers incorrect.
Same model, seed, controls, limits and gates as v1.
